title: TOEIC 每日練習 Day 29（2026-11-26）
summary: 最新成績仍是 Day 15 的 15/25，Day 16 之後還沒收到交卷。今天繼續加強：keep／make／find + 受詞 + 形容詞（含 surprisingly easy 副詞對照、information 名詞陷阱），以及閱讀、聽力的「時間與數字干擾」。另外複習 if 子句配 will／would、In spite of／Although、comply with、whose／who、in charge of、at + 時刻。聽力今天是 Part 3 對話。做完按「交卷」就會自動回傳成績

sections.heading: Part 5 文法與字彙（建議 11 分鐘）
sections.tip: keep／make／find + 受詞 + 空格：描述受詞用形容詞（extremely 後面也是形容詞）；空格後面若還有形容詞，空格就是副詞。假設語氣先看主要子句：will 配 if 現在式，would／could 配 if 過去式。Although 接句子，In spite of 接名詞。時刻用 at。

qs.stem: If the shipment ------- before noon, we will send it to the store today.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 主要子句 will send ＝ 真實可能發生。2. if 子句用現在式，the shipment 單數用 arrives。3. 選 B。

qs.stem: If I ------- more time, I would join the training course.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 主要子句 would join ＝ 與現在事實相反（其實沒時間）。2. if 子句用過去式 had。3. 選 B。

qs.stem: Please keep the hallway ------- at all times.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. keep + 受詞（the hallway）+ 空格，描述走廊的狀態。2. 狀態用形容詞 clear（暢通的）。3. 選 A。

qs.stem: The new manual makes the machine ------- easy to use.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. make + 受詞 + 空格 + easy。2. 空格後已經有形容詞 easy，空格修飾 easy，用副詞 surprisingly。3. 選 B。口訣：空格後還有形容詞 → 副詞；沒有 → 形容詞。

qs.stem: Many visitors found the museum tour extremely -------.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. find + 受詞（the museum tour）+ extremely + 空格。2. extremely 是副詞，後面要接形容詞，而且後面沒有其他形容詞 → informative。3. 選 C。注意 information 是名詞。

qs.stem: ------- the rain, the outdoor concert continued as planned.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. the rain 是名詞，沒有動詞。2. 讓步接名詞用介系詞 In spite of。3. 選 B。Although／Even though 都要接句子。

qs.stem: ------- the store was busy, the staff served every customer quickly.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 空格後有主詞 the store＋動詞 was，是句子。2. 讓步接句子用 Although。3. 選 C。

qs.stem: Visitors must comply ------- the safety rules in the factory.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：comply with ＝ 遵守。看到 comply 直接選 with。

qs.stem: We contacted the customer ------- order was delayed.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 空格後先出現名詞 order，再接動詞 was delayed。2. 「那位顧客『的』訂單」。3. 選 whose。

qs.stem: Ms. Kim is in charge ------- the new marketing project.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. be in charge of ＝ 負責。2. 選 B。對照：be responsible for 用 for，別混。

qs.stem: The training session will begin ------- 10:30 A.M.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 時刻用 at；日期、星期用 on；月份、年份用 in。2. 10:30 A.M. 是時刻，選 C。

sections.heading: Part 7 短篇閱讀（建議 9 分鐘）
sections.tip: 先讀題目、圈關鍵字（purpose、open again、Where、NOT），再回原文找那一句。from…through 是關閉期間，reopen 才是重新開放；房號和電話號碼都是干擾；instead of 前面是新地點。
passage: Riverside Community Center — Main Hall Renovation
The Main Hall will be closed from Monday, December 7, through Thursday, December 10, while new lights and chairs are installed. It will reopen on Friday, December 11, at 8:00 A.M.
During the renovation, all yoga and dance classes will be held in Room 105 instead of the Main Hall. Class times will not change.
Members can borrow chairs for home events at no extra charge after the renovation. For details, call the front desk at 555-0148.

qs.stem: What is the purpose of the notice?
opts: To ask members to pay a fee
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 目的題看標題和第一句：The Main Hall will be closed。2. 暫時關閉 ＝ temporary closure。3. 選 A。

qs.stem: When will the Main Hall open again?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. It will reopen on Friday, December 11。2. A 是開始關閉日；B 是最後關閉日（through ＝ 包含到那天），都是時間干擾。3. 選 C。

qs.stem: Where will yoga classes be held during the renovation?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. held in Room 105 instead of the Main Hall。2. instead of 前面是新地點，後面是舊地點（陷阱）。3. C 用電話號碼 0148 混淆，是數字干擾。選 B。

qs.stem: What is NOT mentioned in the notice?
opts: Class times will stay the same.
Chairs can be borrowed for free.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. NOT 題：逐一核對。2. new lights、Class times will not change、at no extra charge（＝ free）原文都有。3. 原文沒提到停車場，選 D。

sections.heading: Part 2 聽力應答（建議 6 分鐘）
sections.tip: 先聽清楚第一個字（Why don't you／or／Where／Haven't／Who／How often）。建議句不選 Because；A or B 問句和 Wh 問句不選 Yes。重複題目的字或發音相近的字（report／airport、break／broke）通常是陷阱。

qs.stem: Why don't you take a break?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. Why don't you…? ＝ 建議「你何不……」。2. B 接受建議。3. A 是 Because 陷阱；C 用 break／broke 相近字陷阱。

qs.stem: Should we meet in the morning or in the afternoon?
opts: The afternoon works better for me.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. A or B 選擇疑問句，先刪 Yes。2. B 選下午。3. C 重複 morning、用 meet／met，是陷阱。

qs.stem: Where can I find the copy paper?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. Where 問地點。2. A 回答地點。3. B 重複 copy；C 用 paper／newspaper 相近字陷阱。

qs.stem: Haven't you finished the sales report?
opts: Yes, I sent it an hour ago.
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 把 not 拿掉：Have you finished the report?。2. A「有，一小時前寄了」。3. B 用 report／airport 發音相近陷阱；C 用 sales／sale 重複字。

qs.stem: Who is going to lead the training?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. Who 問人。2. B 回答人。3. A 是 Yes 陷阱又重複 going；C 答非所問。

qs.stem: How often is the newsletter sent?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. How often 問頻率。2. A「一個月一次」。3. B 重複 send；C 用 newsletter／new letter 發音陷阱。

sections.heading: Part 3 簡短對話（建議 4 分鐘）
sections.tip: 播放前先讀三題，圈出 Why、What time、do next。對話會出現原本時間、抵達時間和新時間，選 instead 前面的新時間。最後一句通常就是下一步，注意 reserve ＝ book。
script: W: Hi, Tom. Are we still meeting with the clients at two o'clock today?
M: Actually, they called this morning. Their flight was delayed, so they can't make it at two.
W: Oh no. Did they suggest another time?
M: Yes, they asked to meet at four fifteen instead. They'll be here by four.
W: OK. Then I'll reserve the large meeting room for four fifteen right now.

qs.stem: Why does the meeting time change?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 原因題找 because／so 附近：Their flight was delayed, so they can't make it。2. 選 B。

qs.stem: What time will the meeting most likely start?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. meet at four fifteen instead。2. A 是原本時間；B 是客戶抵達時間（by four）；D 不存在。3. instead 前面是新時間，選 C。

qs.stem: What will the woman do next?
qs.exp: 判斷步驟：1. 下一步題聽最後一句：I'll reserve the large meeting room。2. reserve ＝ book（換句話說）。3. 選 B。
